lines.en: Fatima, do you remember the old bank on Eighth Avenue? It was being renovated when we moved here.
lines.pt: Fatima, você se lembra do velho banco na Eighth Avenue? Ele estava sendo reformado quando nos mudamos para cá.

lines.en: Of course. While the roof was being replaced, scaffolding was blocking the pavement for months.
lines.pt: Claro. Enquanto o telhado estava sendo trocado, os andaimes bloqueavam a calçada por meses.

lines.en: And the whole street was being dug up at the same time. Nothing was being done quickly in those days.
lines.pt: E a rua inteira estava sendo escavada ao mesmo tempo. Nada estava sendo feito rápido naquela época.

lines.en: When I walked past it yesterday, the windows were being cleaned, and a new sign was being put up.
lines.pt: Quando passei por lá ontem, as janelas estavam sendo limpas, e uma nova placa estava sendo colocada.

lines.en: I was told last week that a coffee shop was being planned there. Is that true, or is it only a rumour?
lines.pt: Soube na semana passada que uma cafeteria estava sendo planejada ali. É verdade, ou é só boato?

lines.en: Last month the architect was being interviewed on the radio, and he said the old stairs were being kept.
lines.pt: No mês passado o arquiteto estava sendo entrevistado no rádio, e disse que as escadas antigas estavam sendo mantidas.

lines.en: Good news. The old marble floor was being damaged by water, so it had to be repaired quickly.
lines.pt: Boa notícia. O velho piso de mármore estava sendo danificado pela água, então teve de ser consertado rapidamente.

lines.en: I heard that while it was being repaired, a very old coin was found under the stairs.
lines.pt: Ouvi dizer que, enquanto estava sendo consertado, uma moeda muito antiga foi encontrada debaixo da escada.

lines.en: Really? Where is it being kept now? Will it be put on show for the public?
lines.pt: Sério? Onde ela está sendo guardada agora? Será mostrada ao público?

lines.en: It is being studied in a museum, and some photos were being prepared for the local newspaper yesterday.
lines.pt: Ela está sendo estudada em um museu, e algumas fotos estavam sendo preparadas para o jornal local ontem.

lines.en: Brilliant. When the doors open, we should go together and see what was being hidden all those years.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Quando as portas abrirem, devíamos ir juntos ver o que estava sendo escondido todos esses anos.

facts.label: Passivo contínuo no passado
facts.sub: Use para obras ou ações em andamento no passado. Singular: was being repaired. Plural: were being cleaned. Pergunta: Was it being done? Negativa: wasn’t being done.

facts.label: Passivo contínuo (passado)
facts.sub: Use was / were being + particípio para o que estava em andamento no passado: The bank was being renovated. Pense em “estava sendo feito”. Singular: was; plural: were.

facts.label: Duas ações no passado
facts.sub: Use while ou when com um fato curto: A coin was found while the floor was being repaired. O passivo contínuo mostra o fundo da história; o simples, o acontecimento.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The roof was being replaced” describes work in progress in the past.
We say “The windows was being cleaned”.
“Was being” often goes with while or when.

answers: “The roof was being replaced” describes work in progress in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The windows was being cleaned”. → Falso (Plural: were being cleaned.)
“Was being” often goes with while or when. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: An old bank in the city centre · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Saturday in Calgary, and the sky is clear. Dale and Noah walk along Eighth Avenue. They stop in front of an old stone bank. The building has been closed for years. Scaffolding still stands near one wall. The two friends remember how it looked before.

“Noah, do you remember the old bank on Eighth Avenue? It was being renovated when we moved here.” says Dale. “Of course. While the roof was being replaced, scaffolding was blocking the pavement for months.” says Noah. “And the whole street was being dug up at the same time. Nothing was being done quickly in those days.” says Dale.
